podcasts.script: Quick one for the music lovers. Latin R&B singer Marisol Vega is playing her first headline show at Thalia Hall in Pilsen, Chicago, on Friday, December 4. If you love Kali Uchis, Omar Apollo or Cuco, this is very much your kind of night: a first headline show is the one you'll want to say you were at. It's 21+. Grab tickets at {link}. Marisol Vega, Thalia Hall, December 4.
